description: This file contains test functions for the Mattermost server's file upload and retrieval API endpoints, including tests for uploading files, retrieving files, thumbnails, previews, public links, and HEAD requests for file endpoints.

methods.name: escapeQuotes
methods.description: Replaces backslashes and double quotes in a string for safe inclusion in multipart form-data.

methods.name: randomBytes
methods.description: Generates a slice of random bytes of specified length.

methods.name: fileBytes
methods.description: Reads a file from the test directory and returns its bytes.

methods.name: testDoUploadFileRequest
methods.description: Performs an HTTP POST request to upload a file and decodes the response.

methods.name: testUploadFilesPost
methods.description: Uploads multiple files via a multipart POST request.

methods.name: testUploadFilesMultipart
methods.description: Uploads multiple files using multipart form-data, with optional bookmark flag.
